keyPoints: Prakash sanshleshan (photosynthesis): paudhe sunlight se apna khana khud banate hain.
Iske liye 3 cheezen zaroori hain: sunlight, paani (jadon se) aur carbon dioxide (hawa se).
Patton me chlorophyll (hara rang) sunlight ki urja ko pakadta hai.
Carbon dioxide patton ke chhote chhedon (stomata) se andar aati hai.
Samikaran: carbon dioxide + paani -> glucose + oxygen (sunlight aur chlorophyll ki maujoodgi me).
Glucose paudhe ka khana hai; oxygen by-product ke roop me hawa me chhod di jaati hai.
